items.question: Is this tool really free to use?
items.answer: Yes, the Organization Chart Generator is completely free with no hidden costs, subscription fees, or limitations on the number of charts you can create.

items.question: Do I need to create an account or sign up?
items.answer: No registration is required. You can start creating organizational charts immediately without providing any personal information.

items.question: What file format should my employee data be in?
items.answer: The tool accepts CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files. Your spreadsheet should include columns for Name, Position, Department, and Manager Name.

items.question: Can I customize the colors and add my company logo?
items.answer: Yes, you can assign custom colors to each hierarchical level and upload your company logo with the option to toggle its visibility.

items.question: What export formats are available?
items.answer: You can export your chart as a PDF or copy it to your clipboard for use in presentations and documents. Multiple canvas sizes are supported including PowerPoint and Word formats.

items.question: Is my company data secure?
items.answer: Yes, your data is handled securely and stored safely. We don't share or sell your information to third parties, and you have full control over your data.

items.question: Can I edit the chart after importing my CSV file?
items.answer: Yes, you can click on any employee card to edit their name, position, department, or reporting relationships. You can also add new employees manually.
